title: Argentina's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Argentina in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only games from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Nicolas Tagliafico: Nicolas Tagliafico is 11th with 83, one short.
notes.Roberto Ayala: Roberto Ayala won 60 of his 115 caps from 2000 on.
notes.Diego Simeone: Diego Simeone won most of his caps before 2000.

checks: Counted match by match: every Transfermarkt match report for the nation from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026 (starters plus substitutes who came on; scorers, own goals left out; results checked against each match's score, shoot-outs aside), then checked year by year against National Football Teams (its per-year player tables, FIFA and non-FIFA columns added together, September and October 2026 games taken off). Career totals also checked against RSSSF's record players page and Wikipedia (player infoboxes and caps-by-year tables), with games after 19 July 2026 taken off. Zanetti's 97 (145 in all, 48 before 2000) checked against his Wikipedia caps-by-year table. Transfermarkt and National Football Teams agree on every figure in the ten and on Tagliafico's 83 and Tevez's 76. Lautaro Martinez's 84 excludes two caps in October 2026.
